acceptanceCriteria: reproduce on a quiet host and under load with retained timings, or record that it does not reproduce
the handoff deadline or the exec environment cause is identified, and the test passes 3/3 under load ~60 without relaxing the cancellation assertion
body: Observed by the V1-1023/1024 lane (PR #962, head e8f97a3cf, 2026-10-16) on darwin, load 65-84, go1.27.x: `GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=3 -run TestTrustedNavCancellation ./internal/doccompiler/` failed 3/3 in 10.2 s with "timed out waiting for PID handoff at .../grandchild.pid: no such file or directory". The branch does not touch internal/doccompiler. The same script shape run by hand from a temp dir wrote the PID file promptly. Suspected: the 3 s handoff deadline under load, or an exec-environment/sandbox difference. Not reproduced on a quiet host. Suspected defect, not confirmed. Related load class: V1-1446, V1-1353's load flakes.
title: tests (suspected): internal/doccompiler TestTrustedNavCancellation times out on PID handoff under load
